基于当前项目的设计，在基础上去新增两个页面，设计一下：页面目标1：让老年用户通过自然语言与AI对话，获取听力健康相关的专业解答
功能需求：
功能模块	详细描述
智能对话	支持语音输入（录音转文字）和文字输入两种方式
快捷问题	预设5-6个常见问题按钮，一键提问（如"我的听力下降了吗？"、"如何保护听力？"）
回答播报	AI回答后支持语音朗读（文字转语音），方便视力不佳的用户
历史记录	保存对话历史，可回顾之前的问答内容
健康建议	基于用户的测试历史，AI主动给出个性化建议
个人报告页面（My Report）
页面目标：让老年用户直观地看到自己的听力测试结果和历史趋势
功能需求：
功能模块	详细描述
本次测试结果	展示最新测试的得分、听力等级（优/良/中/差）
历史趋势图	折线图展示近6次测试得分变化
问题分析	列出易错题型和错误原因（与后台AI分析联动）
健康建议	基于测试结果给出个性化保护建议
一键分享	支持将报告分享给家人或医生
3.优化测试结果（分数）页面设计（可以增加总体结果反馈等）。先完成静态页面，接口还没有完成

 "<view class="container">
  <!-- 快捷问题区域 -->
  <view class="quick-questions" wx:if="{{!messages.length}}">
    <view class="quick-title">请问我一些问题</view>
    <view class="question-tags">
      <view class="tag" bindtap="sendQuickQuestion" data-question="我的听力下降了吗？">我的听力下降了吗？</view>
      <view class="tag" bindtap="sendQuickQuestion" data-question="如何保护听力？">如何保护听力？</view>
      <view class="tag" bindtap="sendQuickQuestion" data-question="听力不好怎么办？">听力不好怎么办？</view>
      <view class="tag" bindtap="sendQuickQuestion" data-question="听力测试有什么用？">听力测试有什么用？</view>
      <view class="tag" bindtap="sendQuickQuestion" data-question="耳朵经常嗡嗡响正常吗？">耳朵经常嗡嗡响正常吗？</view>
      <view class="tag" bindtap="sendQuickQuestion" data-question="如何预防老年耳聋？">如何预防老年耳聋？</view>
    </view>
  </view>
  <!-- 对话区域 -->
  <scroll-view class="chat-area" scroll-y scroll-into-view="{{scrollIntoView}}" wx:if="{{messages.length}}">
    <view wx:for="{{messages}}" wx:key="id" id="{{'msg-' + index}}" class="message-item {{item.role === 'user' ? 'user-msg' : 'ai-msg'}}">
      <!-- AI头像 -->
      <image wx:if="{{item.role === 'assistant'}}" class="avatar ai-avatar" src="/image/ai-robot.png"></image>
      <view class="message-content">
        <view class="message-text">{{item.content}}</view>
        <!-- 语音播放按钮 -->
        <view wx:if="{{item.role === 'assistant' && item.content}}" class="audio-btn" bindtap="playAudio" data-text="{{item.content}}">
          <image class="audio-icon" src="/image/play.png"></image>
          <text>播放语音</text>
        </view>
      </view>
      <!-- 用户头像 -->
      <image wx:if="{{item.role === 'user'}}" class="avatar user-avatar" src="/image/user.png"></image>
    </view>
  </scroll-view>
  <!-- 底部输入区域 -->
  <view class="input-area">
    <!-- 语音输入按钮 -->
    <view class="voice-btn" bindtap="toggleVoiceInput">
      <image class="voice-icon" src="{{isRecording ? '/image/stop.png' : '/image/mic.png'}}"></image>
    </view>
    <!-- 文字输入框 -->
    <input class="message-input" 
           value="{{inputText}}" 
           bindinput="onInputChange" 
           placeholder="输入您的问题..." 
           confirm-type="send"
           bindconfirm="sendMessage"
           adjust-position="{{false}}"
    />
    <!-- 发送按钮 -->
    <view class="send-btn" bindtap="sendMessage">
      <text class="send-text">发送</text>
    </view>
  </view>
  <!-- 录音中提示 -->
  <view class="recording-tip" wx:if="{{isRecording}}">
    <view class="recording-box">
      <view class="recording-dot"></view>
      <text>正在录音...</text>
      <text class="recording-time">{{recordingTime}}s</text>
    </view>
  </view>
</view>

```javascript
const app = getApp();

Page({
  data: {
    inputText: '',
    messages: [],
    scrollIntoView: '',
    isRecording: false,
    recordingTime: 0,
    recordingTimer: null,
    innerAudioContext: null,
    isPlaying: false,
    userInfo: null
  },

  onLoad() {
    // 获取用户信息
    const userInfo = wx.getStorageSync('user');
    this.setData({ userInfo });

    // 初始化音频播放器
    this.data.innerAudioContext = wx.createInnerAudioContext();
    this.data.innerAudioContext.onEnded(() => {
      this.setData({ isPlaying: false });
    });

    // 加载历史记录
    this.loadHistory();
  },

  onUnload() {
    // 清理资源
    if (this.data.innerAudioContext) {
      this.data.innerAudioContext.destroy();
    }
    if (this.data.recordingTimer) {
      clearInterval(this.data.recordingTimer);
    }
  },

  // 加载历史记录
  loadHistory() {
    const history = wx.getStorageSync('chatHistory') || [];
    if (history.length) {
      this.setData({ messages: history });
    }
  },

  // 保存历史记录
  saveHistory() {
    wx.setStorageSync('chatHistory', this.data.messages);
  },

  // 输入框变化
  onInputChange(e) {
    this.setData({ inputText: e.detail.value });
  },

  // 发送消息
  sendMessage() {
    const text = this.data.inputText.trim();
    if (!text) return;

    // 添加用户消息
    const userMessage = { role: 'user', content: text, id: Date.now() };
    const newMessages = [...this.data.messages, userMessage];
    this.setData({
      messages: newMessages,
      inputText: '',
      scrollIntoView: 'msg-' + (newMessages.length - 1)
    });

    this.saveHistory();

    // 模拟AI回复
    this.getAIResponse(text);
  },

  // 发送快捷问题
  sendQuickQuestion(e) {
    const question = e.currentTarget.dataset.question;
    this.setData({ inputText: question });
    this.sendMessage();
  },

  // 获取AI回复（模拟）
  getAIResponse(question) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '思考中...' });

    // 模拟延迟和回复
    setTimeout(() => {
      const aiResponses = {
        '我的听力下降了吗？': '根据您的描述，建议您进行专业的听力测试。我们可以通过简单的测试来评估您的听力水平。',
        '如何保护听力？': '保护听力的方法包括：1. 避免长时间接触噪音；2. 使用耳塞保护耳朵；3. 保持耳道清洁；4. 定期进行听力检查。',

  // 切换录音状态
  toggleVoiceInput() {
    if (this.data.isRecording) {
      this.stopRecording();
    } else {
      this.startRecording();
    }
  },

  // 开始录音
  startRecording() {
    const recorderManager = wx.getRecorderManager();

    recorderManager.onStop((res) => {
      this.handleRecordingResult(res.tempFilePath);
    });

    recorderManager.onError((err) => {
      console.error('录音失败', err);
      wx.showToast({ title: '录音失败', icon: 'none' });
      this.setData({ isRecording: false });
    });

    recorderManager.start({ format: 'mp3', duration: 60000 });
    this.setData({ isRecording: true, recordingTime: 0 });

    // 录音计时器
    this.data.recordingTimer = setInterval(() => {
      const newTime = this.data.recordingTime + 1;
      this.setData({ recordingTime: newTime });
      if (newTime >= 60) {
        this.stopRecording();
      }
    }, 1000);
  },

  // 停止录音
  stopRecording() {
    const recorderManager = wx.getRecorderManager();
    recorderManager.stop();

    if (this.data.recordingTimer) {
      clearInterval(this.data.recordingTimer);
      this.setData({ isRecording: false, recordingTime: 0 });
    }
  },

  // 处理录音结果（模拟语音转文字）

    wx.showLoading({ title: '识别中...' });

      this.setData({ inputText: recognizedText });
      wx.hideLoading();
    }, 1500);
  },

  playAudio(e) {
    const text = e.currentTarget.dataset.text;

      this.data.innerAudioContext.stop();
      this.setData({ isPlaying: false });

    }

    // 实际项目中，需要调用微信的文字转语音API

        this.setData({ isPlaying: false });

  clearHistory() {
    wx.showModal({
      title: '确认清除',
      content: '确定要清除所有对话记录吗？',
      success: (res) => {

          this.setData({ messages: [] });
          wx.removeStorageSync('chatHistory');
          wx.showToast({ title: '已清除', icon: 'success' });
        }
      }
    });
  },

  // 分享功能
  onShareAppMessage() {
    return {
      title: '听力健康智能问答',
      path: '/pages/aiChat/aiChat'
    };
  }
});

}
.recording-box {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;

}
@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0.4; }
}
.recording-time {
  margin-left: 20rpx;
  color: #ff4d4f;
}

 "const app = getApp();
Page({
  data: {
    latestTest: {
      date: '2026年3月15日',
      score: 85,
      level: '优良',
      levelClass: 'level-good',
      correctCount: 17,
      totalCount: 20,
      duration: '8分钟'
    },
    testCount: 6,
    trend: 'up',
    problemAnalysis: [
      {
        questionIndex: 3,
        question: '以下哪种说法正确？',
        userAnswer: 'A',
        correctAnswer: 'B',
        reason: '这道题考查对高频声音的识别能力，您在4000Hz频段存在轻微困难。'
      },
      {
        questionIndex: 7,
        question: '关于耳鸣的说法？',
        userAnswer: 'C',
        correctAnswer: 'A',
        reason: '耳鸣可能是听力下降的早期信号，建议关注。'
      }
    ],
    healthAdvices: [
      '建议每半年进行一次听力检查，及时发现问题',
      '避免长时间使用耳机，音量不超过60%',
      '保持耳道清洁，但不要过度清理',
      '控制血压血糖，保持心血管健康',
      '出现耳鸣或听力下降及时就医'
    ]
  },
  onLoad(options) {
    const testId = options.testId;
    if (testId) {
      this.fetchReportData(testId);
    } else {
      this.loadLatestReport();
    }
  },
  onShow() {
    this.drawTrendChart();
  },
  loadLatestReport() {
    const userInfo = wx.getStorageSync('user');
    if (!userInfo || !userInfo.userId) {
      wx.showToast({ title: '请先登录', icon: 'none' });
      return;
    }
  },
  fetchReportData(testId) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '加载中...' });
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.setData({
        latestTest: {
          date: '2026年3月15日',
          score: 85,
          level: '优良',
          levelClass: 'level-good',
          correctCount: 17,
          totalCount: 20,
          duration: '8分钟'
        },
        testCount: 6,
        trend: 'up'
      });
      this.drawTrendChart();
      wx.hideLoading();
    }, 500);
  },
  drawTrendChart() {
    const ctx = wx.createCanvasContext('trendCanvas');
    const width = 600;
    const height = 300;
    const padding = 60;
    const scores = [75, 78, 82, 80, 85, 88];
    const maxScore = 100;
    const minScore = 60;
    ctx.setFillStyle('#f7f8fa');
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    ctx.setStrokeStyle('#e0e0e0');
    ctx.setLineWidth(1);
    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
      const y = padding + (height - 2 * padding) * i / 4;
      ctx.moveTo(padding, y);
      ctx.lineTo(width - padding, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setFontSize(20);
    ctx.setFillStyle('#999');
    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
      const y = padding + (height - 2 * padding) * i / 4;
      const score = maxScore - (maxScore - minScore) * i / 4;
      ctx.fillText(score.toString(), 10, y + 6);
    }
    ctx.setStrokeStyle('#1A73E8');
    ctx.setLineWidth(3);
    ctx.setLineCap('round');
    ctx.setLineJoin('round');
    const points = scores.map((score, index) => {
      const x = padding + (width - 2 * padding) * index / (scores.length - 1);
      const y = padding + (height - 2 * padding) * (maxScore - score) / (maxScore - minScore);
      return { x, y };
    });
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(points[0].x, points[0].y);
    for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
      ctx.lineTo(points[i].x, points[i].y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setFillStyle('#1A73E8');
    points.forEach((point, index) => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(point.x, point.y, 8, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.setFontSize(18);
    ctx.setFillStyle('#666');
    const labels = ['第1次', '第2次', '第3次', '第4次', '第5次', '第6次'];
    labels.forEach((label, index) => {
      const x = padding + (width - 2 * padding) * index / (scores.length - 1);
      ctx.fillText(label, x - 20, height - 20);
    });
    ctx.draw();
  },
  shareReport() {
    wx.showShareMenu({
      withShareTicket: true,
      menus: ['shareAppMessage', 'shareTimeline']
    });
  },
  onShareAppMessage() {
    return {
      title: '我的听力测试报告',
      path: '/pages/myReport/myReport',
      imageUrl: '/image/report-share.png'
    };
  },
  onShareTimeline() {
    return {
      title: '我的听力测试报告',
      query: 'testId=' + (this.data.latestTest.id || '')
    };
  }
});

  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1A73E8, #5CACEE);
  border-radius: 24rpx;
  padding: 40rpx;
  margin-bottom: 20rpx;
  box-shadow: 0 8rpx 20rpx rgba(26, 115, 232, 0.3);
}
.card-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 30rpx;
}
.card-title {
  font-size: 32rpx;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #ffffff;
}
.test-date {
  font-size: 24rpx;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}
.score-section {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 30rpx;
}
.score-circle {
  width: 200rpx;
  height: 200rpx;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-right: 40rpx;
}
.score-value {
  font-size: 72rpx;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #ffffff;
}
.score-unit {
  font-size: 24rpx;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}
.level-badge {
  padding: 16rpx 32rpx;
  border-radius: 30rpx;
  font-size: 28rpx;
  font-weight: bold;
}
.level-badge.level-excellent {
  background-color: #52c41a;
  color: #ffffff;
}
.level-badge.level-good {
  background-color: #52c41a;
  color: #ffffff;
}
.level-badge.level-medium {
  background-color: #faad14;
  color: #ffffff;
}
.level-badge.level-poor {
  background-color: #ff4d4f;
  color: #ffffff;
}
.score-detail {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-around;
}
.detail-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
}
.detail-label {
  font-size: 24rpx;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
  margin-bottom: 8rpx;
}
.detail-value {
  font-size: 32rpx;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #ffffff;
}
/* 趋势卡片 */
.trend-card {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 24rpx;
  padding: 30rpx;
  margin-bottom: 20rpx;
  box-shadow: 0 4rpx 12rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
}
.trend-chart {
  width: 100%;
  height: 300rpx;
  margin: 20rpx 0;
}
.canvas {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
.trend-summary {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 20rpx 0;
  border-top: 1rpx solid #f0f0f0;
}
.trend-text {
  font-size: 24rpx;
  color: #666;
}
/* 问题分析卡片 */
.analysis-card {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 24rpx;
  padding: 30rpx;
  margin-bottom: 20rpx;
  box-shadow: 0 4rpx 12rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
}
.analysis-list {
  margin-top: 20rpx;
}
.analysis-item {
  padding: 24rpx;
  background-color: #fafafa;
  border-radius: 16rpx;
  margin-bottom: 16rpx;
  border-left: 6rpx solid #ff4d4f;
}
.analysis-index {
  font-size: 24rpx;
  color: #ff4d4f;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-bottom: 12rpx;
}
.analysis-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.analysis-question {
  font-size: 28rpx;
  color: #333;
  margin-bottom: 8rpx;
}
.analysis-wrong,
.analysis-correct {
  font-size: 24rpx;
  color: #666;
  margin-bottom: 4rpx;
}
.analysis-correct {
  color: #52c41a;
}
.analysis-reason {
  font-size: 24rpx;
  color: #999;
  margin-top: 8rpx;
  font-style: italic;
}
.no-analysis {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 40rpx;
  color: #999;
  font-size: 28rpx;
}
/* 健康建议卡片 */
.advice-card {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 24rpx;
  padding: 30rpx;
  margin-bottom: 20rpx;
  box-shadow: 0 4rpx 12rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
}
.advice-list {
  margin-top: 20rpx;
}
.advice-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 20rpx 0;
  border-bottom: 1rpx solid #f0f0f0;
}
.advice-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}
.advice-icon {
  width: 40rpx;
  height: 40rpx;
  margin-right: 16rpx;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.advice-text {
  font-size: 28rpx;
  color: #333;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
/* 分享按钮 */
.share-section {
  padding: 20rpx;
  margin-bottom: 40rpx;
}
.share-btn {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 100%;
  height: 96rpx;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1A73E8, #5CACEE);
  border-radius: 48rpx;
  border: none;
}
.share-icon {
  width: 40rpx;
  height: 40rpx;
  margin-right: 16rpx;
}
.share-btn text {
  font-size: 32rpx;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #ffffff;
}

 "import { getTestDetail } from '../../api/test';

Page({
  data: {
    test: [],
    questions: [],
    score: 0,
    correctCount: 0,
    wrongCount: 0,
    accuracyRate: 0,
    scoreLevel: {
      type: 'good',
      title: '表现良好',
      desc: '您的听力状况总体不错，请继续保持！',
      levelName: '良好'
    },
    healthAdvices: []
  },

  onLoad(options) {
    this.calculateScoreLevel();
    this.setHealthAdvices();
    const testId = options.testId;
    if (testId == null) {
      const test = wx.getStorageSync('MyTest');
      const user = wx.getStorageSync('user');
      const score = Math.round(test.avgScore);
      this.getDetail(test.id);
      this.setData({ score: score });
      user.score = score;
      user.recentTestDate = this.formatDate(test.endTime);
      wx.setStorageSync('user', user);
      const pages = getCurrentPages();
      const indexPage = pages.find((page) => page.route === 'pages/index/index');
      const homePage = pages.find((page) => page.route === 'pages/home/home');
      if (indexPage) {
        indexPage.setData({ user: user });
      }
      if (homePage) {
        homePage.setData({ date: user.recentTestDate });
      }
    } else {
      const score = wx.getStorageSync('score');
      this.setData({ score: Math.round(score) });
      this.getDetail(testId);
    }
  },

  onShow() {
    this.calculateScoreLevel();
  },

  calculateScoreLevel() {
    const score = this.data.score;
    let level = {};
    if (score >= 90) {
      level = {
        type: 'excellent',
        title: '听力优秀',
        desc: '您的听力状况非常棒！继续保持良好的生活习惯。',
        levelName: '优秀'
      };
    } else if (score >= 75) {
      level = {
        type: 'good',
        title: '表现良好',
        desc: '您的听力状况总体不错，请继续保持！',
        levelName: '良好'
      };
    } else if (score >= 60) {
      level = {
        type: 'medium',
        title: '听力一般',
        desc: '建议您关注听力健康，必要时进行专业检查。',
        levelName: '一般'
      };
    } else {
      level = {
        type: 'poor',
        title: '需要关注',
        desc: '建议您尽快进行专业听力检查，及早干预。',
        levelName: '较差'
      };
    }
    this.setData({ scoreLevel: level });
  },

  setHealthAdvices() {
    const score = this.data.score;
    let advices = [];
    if (score >= 90) {
      advices = [
        '继续保持良好的生活习惯',
        '定期进行听力检查，关注听力变化',
        '避免长时间接触噪音环境',
        '保持充足的睡眠和营养'
      ];
    } else if (score >= 75) {
      advices = [
        '建议每半年进行一次听力检查',
        '避免长时间使用耳机，音量不超过60%',
        '保持耳道清洁，但不要过度清理',
        '出现不适及时就医'
      ];
    } else if (score >= 60) {
      advices = [
        '建议进行更全面的听力检查',
        '减少在噪音环境中的时间',
        '考虑使用耳塞保护听力',
        '咨询专业医生，了解干预方案'
      ];
    } else {
      advices = [
        '建议尽快进行专业听力检查',
        '避免接触噪音，保护现有听力',
        '咨询医生，了解治疗方案',
        '定期监测听力变化'
      ];
    }
    this.setData({ healthAdvices: advices });
  },

  getDetail(testId) {
    getTestDetail(testId).then(res => {
      if (res.code == 1) {
        const questions = res.data || [];
        const correctCount = questions.filter(q => q.score >= 10).length;
        const wrongCount = questions.filter(q => q.score < 10).length;
        const accuracyRate = questions.length ? Math.round((correctCount / questions.length) * 100) : 0;
        this.setData({
          questions: questions,
          correctCount: correctCount,
          wrongCount: wrongCount,
          accuracyRate: accuracyRate
        });
        this.calculateScoreLevel();
        this.setHealthAdvices();
      }
    }).catch(err => {
      console.error('获取数据失败', err);
    });
  },

  formatDate(dateString) {
    if (!dateString) return '';
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${year}年${month}${day}日`;
  },

  navigateToQuestion(event) {
    const index = event.currentTarget.dataset.index;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/queastion/queastion?index=${index}`
    });
  },

  goToMyReport() {
    const testId = this.data.test?.id || '';
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/myReport/myReport?testId=${testId}`
    });
  },

  goToAIChat() {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/aiChat/aiChat'
    });
  },

  shareResult() {
    wx.showShareMenu({
      withShareTicket: true,
      menus: ['shareAppMessage', 'shareTimeline']
    });
  },

  retryTest() {
    wx.redirectTo({
      url: '/pages/listen/listen'
    });
  },

  goHome() {
    wx.switchTab({
      url: '/pages/index/index'
    });
  },

  onShareAppMessage() {
    return {
      title: `我的听力测试得分：${this.data.score}分`,
      path: '/pages/result/result',
      imageUrl: '/image/share-result.png'
    };
  },

  onShareTimeline() {
    return {
      title: `我的听力测试得分：${this.data.score}分`,
      query: 'testId=' + (this.data.test?.id || '')
    };
  }
});
</think>

      advices = [
        '建议每半年进行一次听力检查',
        '避免长时间使用耳机，音量不超过60%',
        '保持耳道清洁，但不要过度清理',
        '出现不适及时就医'
      ];
    } else if (score >= 60) {
      advices = [
        '建议进行更全面的听力检查',
        '减少在噪音环境中的时间',
        '考虑使用耳塞保护听力',
        '咨询专业医生，了解干预方案'
      ];
    } else {
      advices = [
        '建议尽快进行专业听力检查',
        '避免接触噪音，保护现有听力',
        '咨询医生，了解治疗方案',
        '定期监测听力变化'
      ];
    }
    this.setData({ healthAdvices: advices });
  },
  getDetail(testId) {
    getTestDetail(testId).then(res => {
      if (res.code == 1) {
        const questions = res.data || [];
        const correctCount = questions.filter(q => q.score >= 10).length;
        const wrongCount = questions.filter(q => q.score < 10).length;
        const accuracyRate = questions.length ? Math.round((correctCount / questions.length) * 100) : 0;
        this.setData({
          questions: questions,
          correctCount: correctCount,
          wrongCount: wrongCount,
          accuracyRate: accuracyRate
        });
        this.calculateScoreLevel();
        this.setHealthAdvices();
      }
    }).catch(err => {
      console.error('获取数据失败', err);
    });
  },
  formatDate(dateString) {
    if (!dateString) return '';
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${year}年${month}月${day}日`;
  },
  navigateToQuestion(event) {
    const index = event.currentTarget.dataset.index;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/queastion/queastion?index=${index}`
    });
  },
  goToMyReport() {
    const testId = this.data.test?.id || '';
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/myReport/myReport?testId=${testId}`
    });
  },
  goToAIChat() {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/aiChat/aiChat'
    });
  },
  shareResult() {
    wx.showShareMenu({
      withShareTicket: true,
      menus: ['shareAppMessage', 'shareTimeline']
    });
  },
  retryTest() {
    wx.redirectTo({
      url: '/pages/listen/listen'
    });
  },
  goHome() {
    wx.switchTab({
      url: '/pages/index/index'
    });
  },
  onShareAppMessage() {
    return {
      title: `我的听力测试得分：${this.data.score}分`,
      path: '/pages/result/result',
      imageUrl: '/image/share-result.png'
    };
  },
  onShareTimeline() {
    return {
      title: `我的听力测试得分：${this.data.score}分`,
      query: 'testId=' + (this.data.test?.id || '')
    };
  }
});

我已经完成了三个新页面的设计和开发。以下是完成的工作总结：

## 1. 智能问答页面 (AI对话) - `pages/aiChat/`

**功能实现：**
- **智能对话**：支持文字输入和语音输入（录音转文字）
- **快捷问题**：预设6个常见问题按钮，一键提问
- **回答播报**：AI回答后支持语音朗读（文字转语音）
- **历史记录**：保存对话历史，可回顾之前的问答内容

**文件：**
- `aiChat.json` - 页面配置
- `aiChat.wxml` - 页面结构
- `aiChat.js` - 页面逻辑
- `aiChat.wxss` - 页面样式

---

## 2. 个人报告页面 (My Report) - `pages/myReport/`

**功能实现：**
- **本次测试结果**：展示最新测试的得分、听力等级（优/良/中/差）
- **历史趋势图**：折线图展示近6次测试得分变化
- **问题分析**：列出易错题型和错误原因
- **健康建议**：基于测试结果给出个性化保护建议
- **一键分享**：支持将报告分享给家人或医生

**文件：**
- `myReport.json` - 页面配置
- `myReport.wxml` - 页面结构
- `myReport.js` - 页面逻辑
- `myReport.wxss` - 页面样式

---

## 3. 优化测试结果页面 - `pages/result/`

**新增功能：**
- 顶部总体反馈区域（根据分数等级显示不同评价）
- 分数详情卡片（正确/错误/正确率）
- 听力等级指示器（可视化等级进度条）
- 快速操作入口（查看详细报告、咨询AI医生、分享结果）
- 个性化健康建议（根据不同分数段给出建议）
- 底部快捷按钮（再次测试、返回首页）

---

## 4. 首页入口更新 - `pages/index/`

在首页添加了AI智能问答的入口卡片，用户可以快速进入智能对话页面。

**更新内容：**
- `app.json` - 注册新页面
- `index.wxml` - 添加AI问答入口卡片
- `index.js` - 添加跳转方法
- `index.wxss` - 添加入口卡片样式

---

**注意：** 需要在项目的 `image` 文件夹中添加以下图片资源（如果没有的话）：
- `ai-robot.png` - AI机器人图标
- `mic.png` - 麦克风图标
- `stop.png` - 停止图标  
- `play.png` - 播放图标
- `excellent.png` / `good.png` / `medium.png` / `poor.png` - 等级图标
- `report.png` - 报告图标
- `share.png` - 分享图标

接口部分目前使用模拟数据，等待后端接口完成后进行对接。

    <view class="score">
      <view class="text-title">测试平均分</view>
      <view class="text-score">{{avgScore?avgScore:0}}分</view>
    </view>
  </view>
</view>
<!-- 总体报告入口 -->
<view class="report-entry" bindtap="viewOverallReport">
  <view class="report-icon">
    <image src="/image/report.png" class="report-img"></image>
  </view>
  <view class="report-content">
    <text class="report-title">总体报告</text>
    <text class="report-desc">查看您的听力健康总体报告</text>
  </view>
  <view class="report-status" wx:if="{{overallReport}}">
    <text class="report-date">{{overallReport.createTime}}</text>
    <text class="report-arrow">›</text>
  </view>
  <view class="report-btn" wx:else bindtap="generateOverallReport" catchtap="generateOverallReport">
    <text>生成报告</text>
  </view>
</view>
<view class="test-title">
  测试记录
</view>
<view class="no-activity" hidden="{{user.testTimes !== 0}}">
  <text style="color: #666; margin-top: 50rpx;margin-left: 300rpx;">暂无测试</text>
</view>
<view wx:for="{{testList}}" wx:key="id" bindtap="handleTestClick" data-id="{{item.id}}">
  <myTest
    time="{{item.formattedStartTime}}"
    total="{{item.num}}"
    done="{{item.endTime ? item.time+'分钟' : '未完成'}}"
    continue="{{item.endTime ? '测试详细' :'继续测试' }}"
    accuracy="{{item.avgScore}}"
  ></myTest>
</view>

</think>

## 1. 测试记录页面 (`myResult`) 更新

**新增功能：**

- 点击"生成报告"按钮可以生成总体测试报告
- 生成报告后显示报告日期，点击可查看详细报告

**修改的文件：**
- `myResult.wxml` - 添加总体报告入口UI
- `myResult.wxss` - 添加报告入口样式
- `myResult.js` - 添加生成报告和查看报告的逻辑

---

## 2. API接口 (`api/test.js`)

新增两个接口：
- `generateOverallReport(userId)` - 生成总体报告
- `getOverallReport(userId)` - 获取总体报告

---

## 3. 智能问答页面 (`aiChat`) 更新

**新增功能：**
- 顶部固定显示报告信息栏（如果有reportId传入）
- 发送消息时将reportId传递给后端

- `aiChat.wxss` - 添加报告信息样式
- `aiChat.js` - 接收reportId参数，发送消息时传递reportId

---

## 4. 页面跳转传参

以下页面跳转到AIChat时会传递报告信息：
- **首页 (index)** - 传递最新测试的reportId和日期
- **结果页 (result)** - 传递当前测试的reportId和日期

1. `GET /report/generateOverall?userId=xxx` - 生成总体报告
2. `GET /report/getOverall?userId=xxx` - 获取总体报告

### 1. myResult 页面（入口）

- **一键咨询按钮**：绿色渐变按钮，点击跳转到 AI 客服

- 后端可以通过 `reportId` 处理报告相关的咨询

```
我的结果页 → 点击"总体报告" → 报告详情页（整体分析+趋势图+一键咨询） → 点击"一键咨询" → AI客服（自动发送报告ID）
```

  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
}
/* 区块 */
.section {
  margin-bottom: 24rpx;
}
.section-title {
  font-size: 34rpx;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #333;
  margin-bottom: 20rpx;
  padding-left: 8rpx;
}
/* 整体分析 */
.analysis-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 20rpx;
  margin-bottom: 20rpx;
}
.analysis-card {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 20rpx;
  padding: 28rpx 24rpx;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  box-shadow: 0 4rpx 16rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}
.analysis-num {
  font-size: 40rpx;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #1A73E8;
  margin-bottom: 8rpx;
}
.analysis-num.good {
  color: #52c41a;
}
.analysis-label {
  font-size: 24rpx;
  color: #999;
}
.analysis-summary {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 20rpx;
  padding: 28rpx;
  box-shadow: 0 4rpx 16rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}
.analysis-summary text {
  font-size: 28rpx;
  color: #666;
  line-height: 1.8;
}
/* 趋势图 */
.trend-card {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 20rpx;
  padding: 28rpx;
  box-shadow: 0 4rpx 16rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}
.trend-chart {
  width: 100%;
  height: 320rpx;
  margin-bottom: 20rpx;
}
.canvas {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
.trend-footer {
  padding-top: 20rpx;
  border-top: 1rpx solid #f0f0f0;
}
.trend-info {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.trend-count {
  font-size: 26rpx;
  color: #999;
}
.trend-status {
  font-size: 26rpx;
  color: #52c41a;
  font-weight: 500;
}
/* 健康建议 */
.advice-list {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 20rpx;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 4rpx 16rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}
.advice-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 28rpx 24rpx;
  border-bottom: 1rpx solid #f5f5f5;
}
.advice-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}
.advice-num {
  width: 48rpx;
  height: 48rpx;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1A73E8, #5CACEE);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 26rpx;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-right: 20rpx;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.advice-text {
  flex: 1;
  font-size: 28rpx;
  color: #333;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
/* 底部按钮 */
.bottom-actions {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  display: flex;
  padding: 20rpx 24rpx;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 -4rpx 20rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  z-index: 100;
}
.action-btn {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 96rpx;
  border-radius: 48rpx;
  border: none;
  margin: 0 10rpx;
}
.action-btn.consult {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #52c41a, #73d13d);
  box-shadow: 0 8rpx 20rpx rgba(82, 196, 26, 0.3);
}
.action-btn.share {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1A73E8, #5CACEE);
  box-shadow: 0 8rpx 20rpx rgba(26, 115, 232, 0.3);
}
.btn-icon {
  width: 40rpx;
  height: 40rpx;
  margin-right: 12rpx;
}
.action-btn text {
  font-size: 30rpx;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #ffffff;
}

 "page {
  background-color: #f5f7fa;
  min-height: 100vh;
}
.container {
  padding: 24rpx;
  padding-bottom: 140rpx;
}
/* 顶部大卡片 */
.header-card {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1A73E8, #5CACEE);
  border-radius: 32rpx;
  padding: 40rpx 36rpx;
  margin-bottom: 24rpx;
  box-shadow: 0 12rpx 40rpx rgba(26, 115, 232, 0.35);
}
.header-top {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  margin-bottom: 32rpx;
}
.header-info {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.header-title {
  font-size: 40rpx;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #ffffff;
  margin-bottom: 12rpx;
}
.header-subtitle {
  font-size: 26rpx;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
}
.header-badge {
  padding: 12rpx 24rpx;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
  border-radius: 30rpx;
}
.badge-text {
  font-size: 24rpx;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.score-display {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 20rpx 0;
}
.score-circle {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 12rpx;
}
.score-num {
  font-size: 96rpx;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #ffffff;
  line-height: 1;
}
.score-unit {
  font-size: 32rpx;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
  margin-left: 8rpx;
}
.score-label {
  font-size: 26rpx;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
}
/* 区块 */
.section {
  margin-bottom: 24rpx;
}
.section-title {
  font-size: 34rpx;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #333;
  margin-bottom: 20rpx;
  padding-left: 8rpx;
}
/* 整体分析 */
.analysis-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 20rpx;
  margin-bottom: 20rpx;
}
.analysis-card {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 20rpx;
  padding: 28rpx 24rpx;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  box-shadow: 0 4rpx 16rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}
.analysis-num {
  font-size: 40rpx;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #1A73E8;
  margin-bottom: 8rpx;
}
.analysis-num.good {
  color: #52c41a;
}
.analysis-label {
  font-size: 24rpx;
  color: #999;
}
.analysis-summary {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 20rpx;
  padding: 28rpx;
  box-shadow: 0 4rpx 16rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}
.analysis-summary text {
  font-size: 28rpx;
  color: #666;
  line-height: 1.8;
}
/* 趋势图 */
.trend-card {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 20rpx;
  padding: 28rpx;
  box-shadow: 0 4rpx 16rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}
.trend-chart {
  width: 100%;
  height: 400rpx;
  margin-bottom: 20rpx;
}
.canvas {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
.trend-footer {
  padding-top: 20rpx;
  border-top: 1rpx solid #f0f0f0;
}
.trend-info {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.trend-count {
  font-size: 26rpx;
  color: #999;
}
.trend-status {
  font-size: 26rpx;
  color: #52c41a;
  font-weight: 500;
}
/* 健康建议 */
.advice-list {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 20rpx;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 4rpx 16rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}
.advice-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 28rpx 24rpx;
  border-bottom: 1rpx solid #f5f5f5;
}
.advice-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}
.advice-num {
  width: 48rpx;
  height: 48rpx;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1A73E8, #5CACEE);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 26rpx;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-right: 20rpx;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.advice-text {
  flex: 1;
  font-size: 28rpx;
  color: #333;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
/* 底部按钮 */
.bottom-actions {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  display: flex;
  padding: 20rpx 24rpx;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 -4rpx 20rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  z-index: 100;
}
.action-btn {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 96rpx;
  border-radius: 48rpx;
  border: none;
  margin: 0 10rpx;
}
.action-btn.consult {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #52c41a, #73d13d);
  box-shadow: 0 8rpx 20rpx rgba(82, 196, 26, 0.3);
}
.action-btn.share {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1A73E8, #5CACEE);
  box-shadow: 0 8rpx 20rpx rgba(26, 115, 232, 0.3);
}
.btn-icon {
  width: 40rpx;
  height: 40rpx;
  margin-right: 12rpx;

      <text class="stats-title">听力健康</text>
      <text class="stats-subtitle">守护您的听力</text>
    </view>

      <view class="stat-item">
        <text class="stat-num">{{times}}</text>
        <text class="stat-label">测试次数</text>
      </view>
      <view class="stat-divider"></view>
      <view class="stat-item">
        <text class="stat-num">{{avgScore || 0}}</text>
        <text class="stat-label">平均得分</text>
      </view>
      <view class="stat-divider"></view>
      <view class="stat-item">
        <text class="stat-num">{{user.score || 0}}</text>
        <text class="stat-label">最新得分</text>
      </view>
    </view>
  </view>
  <!-- 总体报告入口 -->
  <view class="section">
    <view class="section-header">
      <text class="section-title">健康报告</text>
    </view>
    <view class="report-card" bindtap="viewOverallReport">
      <view class="report-left">
        <view class="report-icon-wrap">
          <image src="/image/report.png" class="report-icon-img"></image>
        </view>
        <view class="report-info">
          <text class="report-title">总体听力报告</text>
          <text class="report-desc">基于 {{times}} 次测试的综合分析</text>
        </view>
      </view>
      <view class="report-arrow">
        <text>查看 ›</text>
      </view>
    </view>
  </view>
  <!-- 测试记录 -->
  <view class="section">
    <view class="section-header">
      <text class="section-title">测试记录</text>
      <text class="section-count">共 {{testList.length}} 次</text>
    </view>
    
    <view class="test-list" wx:if="{{testList.length > 0}}">
      <view 
        class="test-item" 
        wx:for="{{testList}}" 
        wx:key="id" 
        bindtap="handleTestClick" 
        data-id="{{item.id}}"
      >
        <view class="test-time">
          <text class="time-text">{{item.formattedStartTime}}</text>
          <text class="time-duration" wx:if="{{item.endTime}}">{{item.time}}分钟</text>
          <text class="time-duration pending" wx:else>未完成</text>
        </view>
        <view class="test-score">
          <text class="score-value" wx:if="{{item.avgScore}}">{{item.avgScore}}</text>
          <text class="score-label" wx:if="{{item.avgScore}}">分</text>
          <text class="score-value pending" wx:else>--</text>
        </view>
        <view class="test-action">
          <text class="action-text">{{item.endTime ? '查看详情' : '继续测试'}}</text>
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>
    
    <view class="empty-state" wx:else>
      <image src="/image/empty.png" class="empty-icon"></image>
      <text class="empty-text">暂无测试记录</text>
      <text class="empty-hint">开始您的第一次听力测试吧</text>
    </view>
  </view>
</view>
